mutations.name: a rewrite round reverts no beat for the word budget
kills: rewriteScript guard and revert reverts a beat whose rewrite takes it over its word cap, and keeps the rest of the round

mutations.name: a block over its cap reverts every rewritten beat in it
kills: rewriteScript guard and revert reverts the beats that grew a profile block past its cap, and not the one that shrank

mutations.name: a rewrite round no longer reverts a beat that breaks the template fill
mutations.find: gainedBudget(script, merged.beats, merged.rewritten), gainedFill(script, merged.beats, merged.rewritten));
kills: rewriteScript guard and revert reverts a beat whose appended label gives its 5-row list a sixth row the template fill refuses

mutations.name: a rewrite reply is judged without re-declaring its readings
kills: rewriteScript guard and revert re-declares a reading the rewrite dropped, so the beat is kept rather than reverted for Q-V10

mutations.name: a rewrite round keeps a beat the guard rejects
kills: rewriteScript guard and revert keeps a beat whose rewrite cuts the number a cue lands on, and reports the lost cue
